name: Cross_Line_Trader
summary: Cross Line Trader is an Expert Advisor that generates trade signals based on the crossover of two moving average lines. It enters long positions when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and enters short positions when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: Cross Line Trader是一个基于两条均线交叉信号产生交易信号的智能交易系统。当快速均线上穿慢速均线时开多仓，当快速均线下穿慢速均线时开空仓，具有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是经典的均线交叉系统，通过快速均线与慢速均线的交叉来判断趋势方向的变化。入场条件为快速均线上穿慢速均线时做多，快速均线下穿慢速均线时做空。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，当价格触及止损或止盈时自动平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA允许用户固定手数进行交易，但缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，仅依赖固定止损进行风险控制，没有包含资金比例计算或动态风险调整功能。整体策略逻辑简单直观，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is the classic moving average crossover system, which uses the intersection of fast and slow moving averages to detect trend direction changes. Entry conditions are a long position when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA, and a short position when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. Exit conditions rely on pre-configured stop loss and take profit levels, with positions automatically closed when price hits either level. In terms of position sizing, the EA allows users to set a fixed lot size for trading but lacks any dynamic position adjustment mechanism. For money management, it relies solely on fixed stop loss for risk control, without equity-proportional sizing or dynamic risk adjustment features. The overall strategy logic is simple and intuitive, but it is prone to generating frequent false signals in ranging markets, which can lead to consecutive losses.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
参数可配置，用户可以灵活调整均线周期和风控参数
经典趋势跟踪方法，在明确趋势行情中表现良好
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and verify
Configurable parameters allow flexible adjustment of MA periods and risk control settings
Classic trend-following approach performs well in clear trending markets
cons: 均线交叉信号滞后，入场时机偏晚导致利润空间缩小
在震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号，容易连续亏损
缺乏动态仓位管理和资金比例计算，风险控制不够精细
cons_en: MA crossover signals are lagging, leading to late entries and reduced profit potential
Frequent false signals in ranging markets can cause consecutive losses
Lacks dynamic position sizing and equity-proportional calculation, resulting in insufficient risk granularity
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更高周期均线）以减少震荡行情中的虚假信号
引入动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和风险比例自动计算交易手数
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as ADX or higher timeframe MA) to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Introduce dynamic position sizing that automatically calculates lot size based on account equity and risk ratio

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
固定手数交易未考虑账户资金比例，小账户可能过度承担风险
risk_points_en: Lacks new bar check, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
Fixed lot trading without equity-proportional sizing may cause excessive risk for small accounts
